verses.text: "I was ready to be found by those who did not ask for me. I was found by those who did not look for me. To a nation that did not call on my name, I said, 'Here I am, here I am.'
All day long I held out my hands to a stubborn people, who walk in ways that are not good, following their own ideas.
They are a people who keep insulting me to my face, offering sacrifices in gardens and burning incense on altars of brick.
They sit among the graves and spend the night in secret places. They eat pork, and their pots are full of soup made from unclean meat.
They say, 'Stay away! Do not come near me, for I am too holy for you!' These people are like smoke in my nose, a fire that keeps burning all day long.
Look, it is written down before me: I will not keep silent. I will pay them back in full. I will pour it into their laps,

both for your sins and the sins of your ancestors," says the LORD. "Because they burned incense on the mountains and insulted me on the hills, I will measure out into their laps the full payment for what they have done."

This is what the LORD says: "When juice is still found in a cluster of grapes, people say, 'Do not destroy it, there is still something good in it.' In the same way, I will act for the sake of my servants. I will not destroy them all.
I will bring out descendants from Jacob, and from Judah those who will own my mountains. My chosen people will receive the land, and my servants will live there.
Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for cattle, for my people who look for me.
But you who turn away from the LORD and forget my holy mountain, who set a table for the god called Luck and fill bowls of mixed wine for the god called Fate,

I will choose you for the sword, and all of you will bow down to be killed. For I called, but you did not answer. I spoke, but you did not listen. You did what is evil in my eyes and chose what does not please me."
So this is what the Lord GOD says: "Look, my servants will eat, but you will go hungry. My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. My servants will celebrate, but you will be put to shame.
My servants will sing from the joy of their hearts, but you will cry out from the pain in your hearts and wail with a broken spirit.
Your name will be used as a curse by my chosen people. The Lord GOD will put you to death, but he will give his servants a different name.

Whoever asks for a blessing in the land will ask it by the God of truth. Whoever makes a promise in the land will promise by the God of truth. For the troubles of the past will be forgotten and hidden from my eyes.
Look, I am creating new heavens and a new earth. The things of the past will not be remembered or come to mind.
But be glad and celebrate forever in what I am creating. For look, I am creating Jerusalem to be a delight, and its people to be a joy.
I will celebrate over Jerusalem and take delight in my people. The sound of weeping and crying will never be heard in it again.

Never again will a baby live only a few days, or an old person die before living a full life. Anyone who dies at a hundred will be thought of as young, and anyone who does not reach a hundred will be thought of as cursed.
They will build houses and live in them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
They will not build houses for others to live in, or plant for others to eat. For my people will live as long as trees, and my chosen ones will enjoy the work of their hands for a long time.
They will not work hard for nothing, or have children who meet with disaster. For they will be a people blessed by the LORD, they and their children with them.
Before they call, I will answer. While they are still speaking, I will hear.
The wolf and the lamb will eat together. The lion will eat straw like the ox, and dust will be the snake's food. They will not hurt or destroy anything on all my holy mountain," says the LORD.
